about: The Sacred Armour of Antiriad (Palace Software, 1986), Commodore 64: the game's data at its original addresses. Generated by tools/extract-antiriad.mjs; see games/antiriad/re/README.md.

low.about: zero page, stack and $0200-$0AFF as the loader leaves them: the game's variables (it sets most at start) and its small tables at $06A0-$07FF

rooms.about: room layouts: 32 bytes per room, 4 rows of 8 blocks ($0B00 + room * 32)

charGraphics.about: character definitions the rooms take their character sets from

charColours.about: a colour for each of those characters (its low nibble also tells walls and platforms apart)

graphicsSets.about: which characters each room takes (lists of ranges)

vicBank.about: the VIC-II's bank: screen, sprite shapes, the status panel's characters

soundDriver.about: the music and sound effect driver (6502 code) and its sequences

tables.about: messages, sprite movement scripts, item and enemy tables

underIo.about: RAM under the I/O area: the title screen's character set

underKernal.about: RAM under the KERNAL: screen row addresses, room exits and colours, animation scripts, the panel, tune tables
